verdict.rationale: The only latency figure in the pack is secondhand: a community comment says Cloudflare defined real-time as communication "under 500ms". First-party docs only describe the connection path, saying clients automatically reach the closest Cloudflare location via Anycast, and give no latency number. Missing for 10: a first-party documented end-to-end latency target, measured latency numbers or benchmarks for the media path, independent hands-on latency corroboration, and guidance tying latency to live-conversation suitability.

support.subject: As a developer, the vendor documents an end-to-end latency target or measured latency path suitable for live conversation

citations.quote: User was skeptical of Cloudflare defining real-time as communication "under 500ms,"
it _automatically_ connects to the Cloudflare location closest to them
